final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ReportsTo AS r, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.r AS r, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.t, 0) AS q FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(q) AS a FROM s3) SELECT s3.r, s3.c, s3.q, s3.q - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 10
